- Overestimate prices after recent spikes; model tends to overshoot in bullish sentiment periods.
- Underestimate prices during prolonged negative sentiment; model fails to reflect bearish momentum.
- Lag in correction: model often delays downward adjustments after negative sentiment spikes.
- Mean reversion bias: model overcorrects upward after strong declines, then fails to revert to mean.
- Sentiment-driven bias: when sentiment is strongly negative (e.g., < -0.4), model underperforms; when strongly positive (e.g., > 0.3), model overperforms.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts are prone to overconfidence in short-term momentum; reduce forecast amplitude if sentiment is volatile or mixed.
